name: Mequitazine
summary: Mequitazine (trade name Primalan) is an H1 antagonist and anticholinergic of the phenothiazine chemical class. It is used to treat allergies and rhinitis.

pharmacology.text: Mequitazine (trade name Primalan) is an H1 antagonist and anticholinergic of the phenothiazine chemical class.

uses.text: It is used to treat allergies and rhinitis. It was patented in 1969 and came into medical use in 1976.

sideEffects.en: It can cause drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision and constipation.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能引起嗜睡、口乾、視力模糊與便秘。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能引起嗜睡、口干、视力模糊与便秘。

fact.en: Mequitazine is a phenothiazine, the same three-ring family as the early antipsychotic chlorpromazine, but it is used as an antihistamine for allergies.
fact.zh: Mequitazine 屬於啡噻嗪類，與早期抗精神病藥氯丙嗪同屬三環家族，但它是作為治療過敏的抗組織胺使用。
fact.zhHans: Mequitazine 属于啡噻嗪类，与早期抗精神病药氯丙嗪同属三环家族，但它是作为治疗过敏的抗组织胺使用。
